description: Return a live DEX market snapshot for a Solana mint: the most liquid pair, price, liquidity, 24-hour volume, and pair link. Market data is third-party and can be delayed; it is not a price guarantee. Cost: 1 credit (0.0022 SOL). Example: {"mint":"EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v"}

mint.description: SPL token mint address in Base58 format, not a ticker symbol.

name: get_token_market_snapshot
